faqs.question: How much does flea treatment cost in Jericho?
faqs.answer: Our flea treatment services in Jericho — pricing depends on the size of your property and severity of the infestation. We provide free phone assessments and transparent pricing before beginning any treatment.

faqs.question: How long does flea treatment take to work?
faqs.answer: You'll notice a significant reduction in flea activity within 24-48 hours. Complete elimination typically takes 2-3 weeks as we target all life stages. We often schedule a follow-up treatment to ensure all emerging fleas are eliminated.

faqs.question: Is flea treatment safe for my pets and children?
faqs.answer: Yes, we use EPA-registered products that are safe for pets and children when applied by our trained professionals. We'll provide specific instructions on any precautions to take during and after treatment, typically recommending a 2-4 hour absence during application.

faqs.question: What happens if I still see pests after service?
faqs.answer: If you still notice pest activity after your service, call us and we'll come back to reassess — next steps depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
